title: Replacement System Installations: Progress Share Schedule by Total Project Charges
content:
# Progress share by project size

The progress share of a Replacement System Installations progress installment follows the total of every charge on the project:

| Total of every charge on the project | Progress share |
|---|---|
| $15000.00 or more | 50 percent |
| At least $11000.00 but less than $15000.00 | 40 percent |
| Less than $11000.00 | 30 percent |

## What is totalled

The total is of every charge entry on the project ledger — the contract-price charge, change-order charges, the permit-fee charge, labor-warranty upgrade charges and accessory charges — before any credit or payment. Credits do not reduce this total.

## Boundaries (hypothetical totals)

| Total of charges | Progress share |
|---|---|
| $10999.99 | 30 percent |
| $11000.00 | 40 percent |
| $14999.99 | 40 percent |
| $15000.00 | 50 percent |

## Cases (hypothetical projects)

- Charges of $14695.00 and $112.00, total $14807.00, with $650.00 of credits: the total of charges is $14807.00, so the share is 40 percent; the credits do not enter the total.
- Charges totalling $15295.00 and $105.00, total $15400.00: 50 percent.
